signals.title: Gladstone bobber with a twist: Henry Cole reveals his favourite motorcycle
signals.summary: Henry Cole has revealed his most personal motorcycle, which is a vintage Gladstone bobber fitted with a Triumph engine. Henry Cole, who recently put his Honda GL1800 Gold Wing DCT up for sale through Doble Motorcycles, has now revealed his most personal motorcycle, which might surprise you. The bike is a vintage Gladstone bobber that has been fitted with a 750cc engine from Triumph, by his good friend Guy ‘Skid’ Willison. Cole’s choice was revealed on the first episode of ‘Henry’s Bikes’ on The Motorbike Show, which Cole presents alongside Willison and Allen Millyard. The bike is special to Cole because it was one of the first motorcycles he bought for his shop. However, it also holds a great deal of significance due to its name, which was inspired by Cole’s chop shop, which was named Gladstone in memory of his great-great-uncle. In terms of building the bike, Cole gave Willison complete freedom to do what he wanted with the Gladstone bobber. This was mentioned by Willison during the episode, with the pair sitting down together to discuss why the bike holds so much importance to them. Willison also admitted that the process of building the Gladstone bobber could only be started if there were no compromises throughout, saying: “I said yes, and I remember one thing. I said there was one condition, and that if we’re going to build the world’s most beautiful bobber, I said, as long as there’s no compromises, and you said, absolutely. So, I thought this is it. I can throw everything I want onto this bike and there’s going to be no compromise. “It cost you a lot of money but we did end up with this. And for us, there was only one engine to stick in it which was a Triumph 750.” In typical Cole and Willison fashion, the episode features a sprinkling of banter and humour, including Willison telling Cole how he designed the frame. To Cole’s surprise, Willison admitted to laying the engine on its side in order to draw a sketch of the frame with chalk. signals.title: A happy ending for Rok Bagoros and his stolen Super Duke stunt bike
signals.summary: The KTM stunt rider has thanked the motorcycle community, a fellow rider and Milan police after his stolen Super Duke was returned undamaged. Rok Bagoros has confirmed that his stolen KTM 1390 Super Duke R Evo has been recovered, bringing a happy ending to a theft that took place while he was attending EICMA 2026 in Milan. The Slovenian stunt rider revealed the news in a social media post, explaining that the motorcycle had been returned to him undamaged, just a week after he discovered that it had been stolen from his van. Much of the credit for the recovery has gone to fellow motorcycle enthusiast Andrea, who responded to Bagoros' original appeal for help and continued searching for the missing KTM after the initial attempts to locate it proved unsuccessful. Working alongside local police in Milan, Andrea helped keep the investigation moving, with information gradually building over the following days. Bagoros eventually received a video call from Andrea and the police team, with his missing Super Duke visible in the background. A post shared by RokBagoros | freestyle moto (@rokbagoros) The bike was subsequently collected by Bagoros and his brother, with the motorcycle making its way back to his workshop within 24 hours. In his post, Bagoros was keen to recognise the efforts of everyone who helped with the search, particularly Andrea and the officers involved in recovering the motorcycle. He also thanked the thousands of people who shared his original appeal, helping to spread the word beyond his immediate circle. "A week ago, I stood next to my van in Milan, staring at broken windows and an empty space where my Super Duke had been. Today, it’s safely back in my workshop. Undamaged. "And this happened because people cared. "Thousands of you shared my post, spread the word and reached out to help. Through that support, I met one motorcycle rider with a huge heart: @andrea_gears_cento "Andrea and I searched the streets until 4am that first night. Nothing. I then had to collect my other bikes from EICMA and drive nine hours home to my heavily pregnant wife. Leaving without the Super Duke was heartbreaking. "He went to the @questuradimilano_official police station, and together with the local police team, kept the search alive. Every day we stayed in touch. Every day, a little more information. A little more hope. "Andrea was on a video call with the police team… and MY SUPER DUKE was standing behind them. "I cried. Honestly, I couldn’t hold it together. "The next day, my brother and I went to pick it up. Within 24 hours, it was home. "One of the officers later sent me a message explaining how much it meant to them to see me so happy. Behind this recovery were people giving their time and effort to help someone they barely knew. I want everyone to see that side of this story too. "To everyone who shared, messaged and cared: you helped this search begin. Andrea: you went far beyond anything I could have asked. To the @poliziadistato team: thank you for your dedication and for bringing this story to a happy ending. "I came back with my motorcycle—and new friends. "From the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU. This is what the motorcycle community means to me." The recovery is a welcome bit of good news following what has been a frustrating couple of weeks for some familiar faces in the motorcycle world. As we also reported, British Superbike racer Scott Redding also fell victim to a vehicle break-in while travelling back from EICMA, with two vans reportedly targeted in France and a mountain bike stolen. Redding shared pictures of the damage on social media, although there has been no confirmation of a recovery in his case. With Bagoros now reunited with his KTM, here's hoping Redding also gets some good news and manages to get his stolen property back. signals.title: Bikers set to honour late teenager Amelia Miller with Suffolk-based escort this month
signals.summary: A motorcycle escort is set to take place in Suffolk later this week to remember Amelia Miller following her tragic death in October. Amelia Miller, 19, from Stowmarket, Suffolk, is set to be remembered on November 20 when a special escort open to all motorcyclists will take place in her honour. The teenager was tragically killed in an accident involving a red Peugeot 107 and a silver Volkswagen Passat last month. The collision took place in Little Stonham on Sunday, October 18, which involved a second teenager who died at the scene. Miller and the teenage boy were both travelling in the Peugeot when the accident occurred, with the former taken to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge where she later died. A tribute from the family, shared via Suffolk Police, said Miller “loved the freedom of having a car”, although she preferred riding motorcycles. A post shared by Mototechniks (@mototechniks) “She was a keen dancer before becoming a photographer. She loved heavy metal and rock music, as well as the occasional farming song. “Amelia left an impression with everyone she met. She struggled with the school environment but left with fantastic grades. She really blossomed around adults in the workplace environment with her sharp mind and wit.” The motorcycle escort will start at Suffolk-based dealership Mototechniks at approximately 12:15pm, before heading to the West Suffolk Crematorium where Miller’s funeral will take place at 1pm. The honouring escort will then conclude at Mototechniks, where food and drinks will be available for riders. Mototechniks is a specialist dealer for Yamaha, Aprilia, Moto Guzzi, Piaggio and Vespa models. According to a social media post from the dealership, all riders are welcome to attend, while Miller’s father, Chris, added: “It's with immense sadness that I'm announcing that the funeral of my daughter Amelia will be held on the 20th November at 1pm at West Suffolk Crematorium. There will be an escort leaving Mototechniks at approximately 12:15pm to follow the hearse from Stowmarket to the crematorium for 1pm. signals.title: One of the longest-serving Harley-Davidson dealerships has shut its doors
signals.summary: The Historic Harley-Davidson dealership in Topeka, Kansas, has closed just two years after celebrating its 75th anniversary. The owner and CEO of one of Harley-Davidson’s longest-operating dealerships in the United States has confirmed the reasons for its closure. The Historic Harley-Davidson dealer in Topeka, Kansas, had stood for nearly eight decades, and just two years ago, celebrated its 75th anniversary. But 77 years after opening its doors, the American dealership has been forced to close for good, marking a sad day for the showroom and Harley-Davidson. Steve Towers, who is the CEO of a network of Harley-Davidson dealerships across the Midwest and Southeast U.S., became the owner of the historic Harley dealer in February 2025. Towers took over ownership when he bought the dealership from Mike Patterson, which was first established by Patterson’s grandfather in 1949. The dealership had been owned and run by the family for four generations prior to Towers becoming its custodian in 2025. Towers issued a statement confirming the site’s official closure on October 28, admitting it was a hard decision, but one that was needed in order to facilitate other business plans. Towers said: "Closing a dealership is never a decision we take lightly. However, as an organization, we must continually evaluate our operations and make strategic decisions that position our company for long-term success. "The closure of Historic Harley-Davidson is a deliberate business decision that allows us to better allocate our resources, strengthen our existing operations, and focus on markets where we see the greatest potential for growth." According to reports, the original plan for the Kansas-based dealer was to operate out of a different location within 12 months of Towers taking over. But this failed to materialise, and despite serving riders for nearly eight decades, the decision to shut its doors was then taken. However, the closure of the Historic Harley-Davidson dealership is not expected to have an impact on other dealers within Towers’ network. signals.title: Scott Redding suffers France van break-in days after Rok Bagoros had his KTM stolen in Milan
signals.summary: Scott Redding says two vans were broken into in France, with a mountain bike stolen, just days after KTM stunt rider Rok Bagoros had his tricked-out 1390 Super Duke R Evo stolen in Milan. Scott Redding has become the latest high-profile motorcycle name to fall victim to vehicle-related theft, after revealing that two vans were broken into during a trip to France, with one mountain bike stolen. The British rider shared details of the incident on Instagram, posting an image of himself standing outside a vehicle with a smashed window. Giving the camera the middle finger, Redding's caption read: "2 vans broken into, 1 MTB stolen. [I]Won 2013 Moto2 Grand Prix. That's part of my history in France." The post comes less than a week after KTM stunt rider Rok Bagoros revealed that his KTM 1390 Super Duke R Evo had been stolen from the back of a van in Milan, Italy, following its appearance at EICMA 2026. Bagoros confirmed that the theft happened at around 9:30pm on 8 November in the Bicocca district of Milan, with images shared on social media showing what appeared to be damage to the van's windows. He subsequently offered a €3,000 reward for information that could lead to the recovery of the bike. A post shared by Scott Redding 🇬🇧 (@reddingpower) The two incidents are unrelated as far as we know, but they make for an unfortunate coincidence, with two well-known figures from the motorcycle world suffering vehicle-related thefts within the space of six days. Redding had also attended EICMA in Milan before continuing his journey through Europe, with his latest post suggesting that his travels took him through France. Whether he was making his way back to the UK after the Italian show or taking some time out along the way is unclear. This is not the first time Redding has spoken about the incident. In an earlier social media post, he showed the damage to his SUV after it was broken into during an overnight stay in France, explaining that a baby seat had been inside the vehicle. The latest post adds the detail that two vans were targeted and that a mountain bike was taken, although Redding has not provided further information about where the break-ins happened or whether anything else was stolen. There is an extra layer of irony to Redding's caption, too. The former MotoGP and WorldSBK rider won the 2013 Moto2 French Grand Prix at Le Mans, beating Mika Kallio and Xavier Siméon to take his first victory in the class. Johann Zarco, who was also competing in Moto2 at the time, was fifth in that race. The Frenchman spotted Redding's post and commented: "They did not know you won in 2013... they were only 5 years old. Sorry for what you went through." Redding, who has been racing in BSB for the last few years, finished second in the 2026 Championship with Hager PBM Racing, narrowly missing out on the title to Kyle Ryde. His plans for the 2027 BSB season have yet to be confirmed. signals.title: Stark Future lands major investment as its electric VARG bikes take on petrol rivals
signals.summary: Barcelona-based Stark Future has secured a financing deal worth more than €150m, valuing the electric motorcycle manufacturer at €1.2 billion. Stark Future has become Europe's first electric motorcycle company to achieve a valuation of more than €1 billion, after closing a financing round with a total transaction value exceeding €150 million (£125 million). The Barcelona-based manufacturer, which produces the VARG range of electric motocross, enduro and supermoto bikes, says the latest deal values the business at €1.2 billion before the investment. It also describes the transaction as the largest investment ever made in a European electric motorcycle company. Investment firm Highland Europe led the funding round, alongside Morgan Stanley Investment Management's 1GT climate private equity strategy and Spain-based Axon Partners Group. Existing shareholders and new investors also participated, while Lombard Odier is among the potential strategic partners being considered for a possible second closing. It's a significant milestone for a company that began selling bikes to customers only three years ago, especially given the difficulties most other manufacturers face in establishing themselves in the electric motorcycle market. It’s also worth remembering that Stark hasn’t built its business in the cheap and cheerful electric commuter end of the market. It went full bore into the premium off-road competition end of the segment, with a belief that electric motorcycles should be capable of outperforming their petrol-powered equivalents, rather than simply offering a zero-emission alternative. Its VARG platform has been central to that strategy, with the company now claiming its enduro model is the best-selling motorcycle in its category worldwide, outselling every combustion-powered rival. According to Stark, the VARG took around 50 per cent of the enduro market in Germany within its first year on sale, while also reaching the top spot in France and Italy. The United States has since become its largest market by sales volume. The company estimates that it has captured around 5 per cent of the global off-road motorcycle market, which it values at approximately €3 billion, in just three years. That is an interesting figure when viewed against the wider electric motorcycle market, where manufacturers have generally found it difficult to persuade traditional riders to make the switch away from petrol. Stark's success suggests there is considerably more appetite for electric motorcycles when performance, rather than environmental credentials, is the main selling point. The company currently manufactures its VARG range at a 20,000-square-metre facility outside Barcelona, with production, engineering and development all handled in-house. The latest investment is intended to support further international expansion and the development of additional electric motorcycle platforms. Stark also wants to move beyond the off-road market and compete in other motorcycle categories, opening up what it describes as a potential €90 billion addressable market. Speaking about the results and what comes next, Stark Futures’ founder and CEO, Anton Wass, said: “Six years ago, Stark was an unwavering belief that electric could be the better machine, not the compromise. Today it’s the largest investment ever made in a European electric motorcycle company. We turned the industry on its head once with the VARG, taking 5% of a €3 billion market from combustion in three years. This gives us the resources to do it again, and more, in a €90 billion market. "While others in this industry have run out of road, we’ve grown, turned profitable, and brought Highland Europe and world-renowned institutional investors on board, and we have kept the door open in the second closing for a few more who share the same ambition. None of it would have happened without the riders who chose a VARG before the world’s biggest investors did, and the dealers who put it on their floors. Thank you for making this dream real. We’re not here to take part in the future of motorcycling. We’re here to lead it.” The new investment provides Stark with considerable financial backing as it looks to expand its product range and take on more established motorcycle manufacturers. Whether it can repeat its off-road success in the much larger on-road market remains to be seen. However, reaching a €1.2 billion valuation after just three years of motorcycle sales is a fairly clear indication that investors believe there is considerable potential in what the company is doing. And while electric motorcycles still have plenty of convincing to do among traditional riders, Stark has at least demonstrated that there is a market for them when the performance argument comes before the environmental claims. signals.summary: Honda has begun offering free 3D models of popular Honda motorcycles to creators. Drawing or producing CG motorcycles can be challenging due to their complex forms. Many creators have shared that the difficulty of accurately depicting motorcycles sometimes leads them to avoid including them in their art works. This initiative began launched in response to those voices. As a company that develops, manufactures, and sells motorcycles, Honda is home to many passionate motorcycle enthusiasts. Employees across generations have been inspired by stories featuring motorcycles from different eras. Many joined Honda after being deeply moved by such works, aspiring to create motorcycles of their own. By providing official assets from the company that builds motorcycles, Honda hopes more creators will incorporate motorcycles into their projects, leading to even more works in which motorcycles play a role. The 3D data provided are not simple exterior replicas. In actual vehicle development, after a design proposal is created, full-scale modeling and digital data are refined back and forth in millimeter increments. The form and materials are repeatedly verified while incorporating riding data. The assets are produced based on the 3D data finalized through real-world development, allowing for precise reproduction of each motorcycle’s details. signals.summary: Over the October 14 - 15 weekend, the 26th Cafe Cub Meeting in Aoyama, a gathering of Super Cub fans, was held in a lively atmosphere at Honda Welcome Plaza Aoyama. This annual event for Super Cub fans to talk about motorcycle culture and socialize with friends over coffee, has been held since 1997. Participants were chosen by lottery, and a total of 379 Super Cubs arrived at the event over two days. On Sunday, 162 Super Cubs gathered despite heavy rain." Participants' Super Cubs neatly lined up outside of Honda Welcome Plaza Aoyama, as passersby looked on with great interest. Over the years, the event has become a Autumn tradition in Aoyama. This year’s theme was "Nicest People on a Super Cub," in the hope of bringing smiles to the faces of Super Cub owners and onlookers alike. The window displayed a poster of the 1963 U.S. ”Nicest People” campaign. Inside the plaza, the CA100 photographed in the poster was on display. Participants were given the red carpet treatment. After reception, they were guided by associates to the exhibits. Cub owners mingled around the exhibits, each Cub unique. Super Cubs from many eras, from the 1960s to now, assembled. Unique numbers were attached to each, later to be used for voting. Some Super Cub-licensed merchandise was also on display, popular with kids and the elderly alike. In “Bike Forum,” a popular talk session at the Cafe Cub meeting, speakers discussed the past, present and future of the Super Cub, celebrating Honda’s 75th, and the Super Cub’s 65th anniversaries. Nonfiction author Hiroshi Nakabe (left) and Miki Press president Kenichi Kobayashi (right) were guest speakers. Both have been involved in publishing many books about the Super Cub. They spoke about how the Super Cub, a high-performance scooter for ordinary people developed with the passion of its founders, Soichiro Honda and Takeo Fujisawa, took off around the world. Another highlight of the Cafe Cub meeting, the Special Award ceremony, in which the Super Cub and its owner selected by Bike Forum guests and Honda Smile associates received commemorative gifts. And, the winners of voting casted by all participants was also awarded. Saturday’s winner was a Super Cub 110 owner. The underground parking at Honda’s Aoyama building was open to the public for the event. 500 vehicles arrived during the two days. The second-floor lobby was opened as a rest space with book and video areas. On Sunday, the area was used to dry helmets and raincoats due to the heavy rain. As a finale to the Cafe Cub meeting, participants tested their paper-scissor-stone skills to win gorgeous prizes. Once Honda Smile associates asked participants to ride home safely, the event came to a close.Participants left with fond memories and promises to reunite with their friends, exchanging information on customization, and listening to historical occurrences at Bike Forum.

signals.title: 温柔外表，配置实在，把松弛感骑在脚下的通勤伙伴｜雅马哈FUZZY125 测评
signals.summary: 提起雅马哈的125cc 踏板，很多人的固有印象大多偏向运动务实，通勤给力，复古风格似乎从来不是它的主场。也正因如此，全新FUZZY125 还未正式面世，就凭借雅马哈少见的复古定位，收获了不少车友的关注和期待。 FUZZY这个单词本意代表毛茸茸、柔软温润，传递出一种松弛舒服的氛围感，放到这台车上，其实也点明了它的产品内核：不追求硬核激进，不刻意比拼速度，主打一份从容不紧绷的城市骑行生活。 整车外观跟“FUZZY”命名一样，没有像大多数复古踏板采用很多硬核冰冷感觉的镀铬装饰，也没有盲目堆砌繁杂的复古元素，整体采用现代复古的设计思路，车身线条圆润流畅，整体观感干净利落，是比较“柔软”的感觉。 圆形的大灯搭配镀铬装饰件，日行灯与前转向灯整合为一体，辨识度很高的“微笑式” 灯组全部采用 LED 光源，点亮之后氛围感十足，尾灯同样延续微笑造型，和车头形成前后呼应，后转向灯则做了分离式的处理。 坐垫使用特殊压花工艺，既区别于纹理起伏较大的毛毛虫坐垫，也不同于毫无设计的普通平坐垫，视觉温润，上手的触感也很有质感。 车身左侧设置封闭式储物盒，兼顾美观与私密性，盒内同时配备USB和 TypeC 双充电接口，即便是下雨天，也可以安心给电子设备供电。座桶空间让人惊喜，能够放下一顶3/4全盔，放完头盔之后依旧留有富余，通勤存放手套、随身杂物完全没有压力。 智能解锁把日常用车的情绪价值拉满，蓝牙感应、NFC卡片、手机 APP、机械钥匙四种解锁方式全部给到。赶时间出门不用慌忙翻找钥匙，如果借车给朋友用，也不用特意跑一趟递送钥匙，跟骑车一样手机操作就可以，多种生活场景都可以轻松适配。 熟悉雅马哈的车友都清楚，品牌过去在125 级别踏板上，配置策略偏向保守，满足基础代步即为优先。而 FUZZY125 直接改变了这个现状，不少配置放在同级别复古踏板身上，属于比较少见的存在。除前面提到的多模式智能解锁之外，还配备了单通道ABS，搭配 ESS 紧急制动双闪，为日常骑行增加一层安全兜底。 胎压监测的加入是一大亮点，这在125踏板中更是较少的存在，对于每日通勤的骑手，轮胎隐患很难肉眼察觉，频繁往返修理店检查胎压也十分耗费精力。这台车可以直接在仪表查看前后胎压，随时掌握轮胎状态，降低通勤路上的潜在风险。 另外还有支持蓝牙互联、导航投屏的6.2 英寸 TFT 全彩仪表，这在125 级别里尺寸很有优势。自动光感大灯也是同级少见的配置，属于小配置起大作用的一项，进出隧道、傍晚光线变暗时灯光自动切换，不需要手动操作，这样可以避免因忘记开灯带来的危险，让注意力始终集中在骑行和路面上。 把ABS、胎压监测、TFT 导航投屏、自动大灯、多重智能解锁集合在一台 125cc 踏板上，放在雅马哈自家产品线里，算得上一次实打实的越级。 来到动态层面先看看座高，以160cm 身高参考还是很有安全感的。765mm从数据上看虽然在125 级别中座高不算低，但对大部分车友依旧友好，等红灯、挪车、拥堵路况都没有负担。骑行姿态舒展，车把高度适中，手臂不用刻意端起，脚踏空间宽裕，双腿摆放自在，长时间骑行身体不容易僵硬疲惫。 动力方面搭载了创核科技2.0 Hybrid 轻混风冷发动机，实际排量 124cc，最大功率 6.1kW，最大扭矩 9.8N・m。账面数据属于 125cc 主流水准，核心亮点是ASST 瞬时起步电助力系统。 这套电助力专门改善小踏板低扭偏弱、起步拖沓的通病。起步阶段电机协同出力，油门给下去响应轻快直接，上坡载人的时候，也不会出现明显动力发闷。日常城市加速到70km/h 的过程平顺，完全可以满足绝大多数城市通勤的速度需求。而且骑行质感不错，从怠速、低速巡航，再到六七十码巡航，全程都没有高频抖动。 操控方面属于125 踏板常规水平，低速挪车、掉头轻巧灵活，穿梭城市车流、街巷小巷，转向手感轻松，女生骑行也不会觉得笨重。 减震调校偏向运动取向，过弯的时候能给到不错的支撑，车身倾倒的时候整体姿态很稳，不会出现发软晃动感，日常城市道路行驶感觉良好，不会过分生硬。 刹车采用前碟后鼓的组合，搭载前轮 ABS。制动力输出线性柔和，不会出现突然闯动抱死。日常轻点刹车就有足够减速效果，ABS的整体调校偏向温和，更贴合通勤骑手的使用习惯，有了ABS的加持，通勤时遇到雨天湿滑路面、路面白线，紧急制动时ABS 及时介入，避免前轮抱死打滑，通勤安全强就足了。 外表是温润松弛的现代复古风格，满足大家对于骑行的审美和情绪向往；内里却没有为了外观牺牲代步硬实力。轻混带来轻快起步，震动控制优秀，城市穿梭灵活好骑，再加上ABS、胎压监测、TFT 导航投屏这一堆越级配置，把城市通勤需要的省心、安全全部兼顾。 它并不追求极致的速度快感，更多聚焦普通人的日常出行。如果你正在寻找一台氛围感在线，同时配置实在、好骑耐用的125 复古踏板，FUZZY125，值得纳入你的考虑范围。 不止千里远征的浪漫，还有日复一日里的放松｜雅马哈如何用MAX Moment深耕本地车主文化

外观上，几款车型采用相同的设计语言，在挡泥瓦、版画等细节方面有调整，灯组比较特别，一颗圆形的大灯，日行灯是倒Y的形状，有很强的机甲科幻感。动力底盘也是采用的同一套，搭载实际排量799cc的并列双缸水冷发动机，最大功率69.5kW，峰值扭矩80Nm，匹配双平衡轴，且该发动机采用75°曲轴设计。滑动离合、双向快排、前KYB后Pro-link减震、钛尺、7寸竖屏TFT仪表、前摄像头+后置雷达、胎压监测、手动可调风挡等均为标配。博世全套六轴IMU、弯道ABS、弯道TCS、防翘头、公路/越野/运动3种骑行模式等电控也没有缺席。 不同的是T802X主打公路旅行，前挡泥瓦采用低位设计，配备前19后17寸轮毂与象牌公路胎；T802XR采用高位挡泥板，轮毂升级为前21后18寸的越野规格，搭配倍耐力全地形胎；T802XR RALLY轮毂、轮胎和制动跟XR一样，但减震行程加长，离地间隙270mm，坐垫、油箱等细节也有不同，十分硬核。 据了解，新款火刃围绕赛道性能，对车架、摇臂、发动机、空气动力学等约75%的零部件进行了重新设计，并提供普通版、SP高配版和HRC Works Edition三个版本。动力搭载999cc的直列四缸水冷发动机，最大马力218匹，最大扭矩114Nm。本田首次在量产摩托车上使用两段式可变长度进气漏斗系统，这套系统能够改善中低转速的动力输出，电子油门、部分发动机部件也进行了升级优化，还配备了天蝎钛合金排气，6轴IMU等也是标配。 区别于其他两个版本，HRC Works Edition 2027款非双不仅迎来了大改款，还在标准版、冒险版的基础上，增加了越野版本。发动机从1084cc提升至1131cc，最大功率87.5kW，在5700rpm爆发119Nm的最大扭矩，提供传统6速手动变速箱和本田DCT双离合变速箱两种选择。 标准版匹配电动风挡、智能钥匙、昭和电子悬挂，六轴IMU整合了电子油门、七段可调循迹控制防浮举控制与引擎刹车调整功能，还有6种骑行模式；冒险版首次提供了本田的 signals.title: Triumph Street Triple 798 RS, more powerful and lighter than ever before
signals.summary: F ollowing its preview right here at EICMA, Triumph is finally unleashing the brand-new Street Triple 798 RS, a machine that is both more powerful and lighter than ever before. The Hinckley manufacturer has overhauled every single aspect of its iconic naked bike , elevating it to an entirely new tier and marking a definitive generational leap forward. The brand-new 798cc triple-cylinder engine was forged on the racetrack, directly derived from the powerplant that fuels the Moto2 World Championship machines, a racing series where Hinckley has stood proudly as the exclusive engine supplier since 2019. Triumph claims an impressive 135 hp at 11,500 rpm and 86 Nm of torque at 9,250 rpm , featuring a 10% boost in torque spread smoothly across the entire rev range. The valvetrain has been completely re-engineered with DLC-coated ultra-lightweight finger followers, larger valves, and a completely redesigned intake, combustion chamber, and exhaust system, while the gearbox, engine casings, and clutch are all entirely new as well. The chassis is completely fresh , crafted from lightweight aluminum alongside the rear subframe and the 15-liter fuel tank, featuring a redesigned double-sided swingarm inspired directly by Moto2. Curb weight drops to a lean 183 kg, setting the lowest weight ever achieved by any Street Triple, while a steeper steering head angle and reduced trail are engineered to maximize sheer agility. The suspension setup is fully adjustable, starring a 41mm Showa Big Piston fork up front and a premium Öhlins STX46 monoshock at the rear. Stopping power is handled by a Brembo braking system featuring twin 310mm floating front discs gripped by four-piston radial monobloc Stylema calipers, paired with an MCS radial master cylinder boasting adjustable span and leverage ratio, while the rear utilizes a 220mm disc with a single-piston caliper. The 17-inch wheels come wrapped in Superbike-derived Pirelli Diablo Supercorsa V3 tires in 120/70 and 190/55 dimensions. The cutting-edge electronics suite includes seven riding modes (five presets and two fully customizable options), launch control, wheelie control, cornering-optimized ABS and traction control complete with rear-wheel slip management, and a bi-directional quickshifter with an auto-blipper. A brilliant 7-inch touchscreen Bosch TFT display with integrated CarPlay and Android Auto rounds out the high-tech equipment. Available in three colourways— Interstellar Blue, Carnival Red, and Sapphire Black —the new Triumph Street Triple 798 RS is already open for pre-orders, with the first deliveries scheduled to roll out in February 2027. © Copyright 2023 Esposizione internazionale del ciclo, motociclo, accessori S.p.A. in sigla E.I.C.M.A. S.p.A - Privacy Policy - Cookie Policy - Condizioni Generali Sede legale: Via Fabio Filzi 25/a, 20124 Milano - Pi e cf: 04145450153 N° iscrizione 04145450153 - Capitale sociale sottoscritto e versato: 100.000 euro Made by Agenzia YES S.p.A.

signals.title: Toyota Raize 1.0 Turbo: SUV Ringkas Andal, Tapi Punya Dilema
signals.summary: Toyota Raize 1.0 Turbo: SUV Ringkas Andal, Tapi Punya Dilema JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Toyota Raize menjadi salah satu produk Toyota yang menarik untuk dijadikan kendaraan harian. Secara bentuk menawarkan gaya SUV ringkas, ditambah pilihan mesin 1.000 cc turbo dan 1.200 cc. Selain spesifikasi di atas kertas, tentu pengalaman pemilik bisa menjadi acuan untuk mengetahui kelebihan dan kekurangan dari mobil andalan Toyota tersebut. Baca juga: Pertamax Turun, Berapa Biaya Isi Full Tank Rocky dan Raize? KOMPAS.com/Muhammad Fathan Radityasani Toyota Raize 1.0 milik Andika Danis Pada tulisan ini, Andika Danis, pemilik Raize 1.0 Turbo lansiran 2023, menceritakan pengalamannya selama menggunakan mobil tersebut. Menurut Andika, Raize 1.0 Turbo merupakan salah satu hasil kolaborasi terbaik antara Toyota dan Daihatsu. Ia menyukai karakter akselerasi serta kehalusan lajunya saat diajak melintas di jalan bebas hambatan. Baca juga: Biskita Trans Depok Koridor 2 Siap Beroperasi, Ini Rute dan Jam Layanannya "Lebih banyak plusnya daripada minusnya. Saya sering senyum sendiri kalau jalanan lancar di tol dengan kecepatan rata-rata stabil karena sehalus itu. Toyota dan Daihatsu berhasil membuat mobil perkotaan, tetapi bisa diadu untuk kecepatan," kata Andika kepada Kompas.com, Minggu (15/11/2026). Ia menambahkan, tenaga mesin 1.000 cc turbo tersebut sangat bisa diandalkan saat melahap rute perbukitan tanpa terasa berat atau ngeden . Caranya dengan memanfaatkan mode manual dan tombol PWR. Meski bertenaga, Andika merasakan adanya dilema ketika memacu Raize di atas kecepatan 100 kilometer per jam. Karakter suspensinya yang empuk berpadu dengan postur bodi yang cukup tinggi membuat mobil terasa kurang stabil saat dipacu kencang. "Jadi ada momen dilema untuk pelan-pelan saja, enggak berani terlalu kencang. Cara menanganinya adalah ingat fungsinya sebagai mobil harian. Kalau bagi para pencinta kecepatan yang ingin lebih stabil, disarankan mengganti pelek dan sedikit menceperkan suspensinya," ujar Andika. Dari sisi kepraktisan, Andika menilai ruang bagasi Raize cukup akomodatif untuk kebutuhan harian maupun hobi, bahkan mampu memuat sepeda. Soal kekedapan kabin, suara dari luar memang masih terdengar, namun menurutnya tidak sampai mengganggu kenyamanan. Sementara untuk urusan efisiensi bahan bakar, konsumsi BBM Raize 1.0 Turbo miliknya tercatat berada di rentang 10 kilometer per liter hingga 19 kilometer per liter, tergantung kondisi lalu lintas dan gaya berkendara. Angka tersebut dirasanya sedikit lebih boros jika dibandingkan dengan mobil lain di garasinya, yakni Toyota Yaris Cross, yang mampu mencatatkan rata-rata konsumsi BBM di atas 20 kilometer per liter. signals.summary: AHM Sebut Target Motor Irit 100 Km per Liter Memungkinkan JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com Target konsumsi bahan bakar minyak (BBM) sepeda motor bensin mencapai 100 kilometer per liter pada periode 2029-2030 dinilai bukan hal yang mustahil. Direktur Marketing PT Astra Honda Motor ( AHM ) Octavianus Dwi Putro mengatakan, target efisiensi tersebut sangat mungkin dicapai melalui pengembangan teknologi mesin. Ya menuju ( 100 km per liter ). Hal tersebut memungkinkan, ujar Octa kepada Kompas.com , dikutip Rabu (18/11/2026). Baca juga: Koleksi Motor MotoGP Milik Gembong Narkoba Laris Dilelang ANTARA FOTO/BASRI MARZUKI Ilustrasi pengisian BBM di SPBU Pertamina menggunakan Pertalite. Ilustrasi Pertalite. Meski demikian, Octa mengakui bahwa upaya meningkatkan efisiensi mesin memiliki tantangan tersendiri. Salah satunya berkaitan dengan keseimbangan antara konsumsi BBM dan performa kendaraan. Menurut dia, AHM terus melakukan pengujian dan pengembangan teknologi baru agar sepeda motor bisa memiliki konsumsi BBM yang semakin irit tanpa mengorbankan performa secara berlebihan. Asosiasi Industri Sepeda Motor Indonesia (AISI) sebelumnya menetapkan target peningkatan efisiensi konsumsi BBM sepeda motor bermesin bensin konvensional hingga 100 km per liter pada periode 2029-2030. Target tersebut cukup menantang mengingat rata-rata konsumsi BBM sepeda motor di Indonesia saat ini berada di kisaran 60 km per liter. Ketua Bidang Komersial AISI Yosef Utama mengatakan, seluruh pabrikan anggota asosiasi terus mengembangkan teknologi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi mesin dari tahun ke tahun. "Arah pengembangan teknologi dari lima pabrikan anggota AISI memang terus meningkatkan efisiensi mesin dari tahun ke tahun, ujar Yosef, kepada Kompas.com , pada Oktober lalu. Namun, produsen juga harus mempertimbangkan kebutuhan konsumen yang tidak hanya menginginkan kendaraan irit, tetapi juga memiliki performa memadai untuk penggunaan sehari-hari. Hal ini menjadi tantangan tersendiri bagi pabrikan dalam merancang mesin dengan konsumsi BBM lebih rendah tanpa mengurangi kemampuan akselerasi maupun tenaga yang dibutuhkan pengendara. signals.title: Adu Spesifikasi AION i60 dan Deepal S05, Mana Lebih Unggul?
signals.summary: Adu Spesifikasi AION i60 dan Deepal S05, Mana Lebih Unggul? JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Persaingan mobil listrik di segmen sport utility vehicle (SUV) semakin ramai dengan hadirnya sejumlah model baru di pasar otomotif Indonesia. Dua di antaranya adalah GAC AION i60 dan Changan Deepal S05. Kedua mobil listrik tersebut sama-sama menyasar konsumen yang membutuhkan SUV dengan kabin lapang, fitur modern, serta kemampuan jelajah yang mumpuni untuk penggunaan harian maupun perjalanan jarak jauh. Dari segi harga, keduanya juga berada di rentang yang berdekatan. Changan Deepal S05 BEV dipasarkan mulai Rp 509 juta, sedangkan harga resmi AION i60 perlu disesuaikan dengan pengumuman harga dari GAC Indonesia. Baca juga: AION i60 Kejar Target TKDN 60 Persen, Siap Lokalisasi Baterai Meski demikian, terdapat sejumlah perbedaan dari segi dimensi, kelengkapan interior, fitur, hingga performa motor listrik dan kapasitas baterai. Dari segi dimensi, AION i60 memiliki bodi yang lebih panjang dan tinggi dibandingkan Deepal S05. Namun, SUV listrik Changan tersebut unggul dalam hal lebar dan jarak sumbu roda atau wheelbase. signals.title: Jorge Martin Bertekad Tunda Pesta Juara Marc Marquez
signals.summary: Jorge Martin Bertekad Tunda Pesta Juara Marc Marquez JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Jorge Martin mengaku berada dalam kondisi fisik yang jauh lebih baik menjelang MotoGP Portugal 2026. Pebalap Aprilia tersebut bertekad memberikan performa terbaik demi menjaga peluang mempertahankan gelar juara dunia hingga seri terakhir di Valencia. Martin sebelumnya harus absen dari MotoGP Malaysia di Sepang setelah mengalami patah pergelangan tangan akibat kecelakaan di Phillip Island. Meski demikian, ia mampu menunjukkan performa kompetitif saat kembali ke lintasan pada MotoGP Qatar. Pebalap asal Spanyol itu berhasil finis di posisi ketiga pada Sprint Race dan menempati urutan ketujuh dalam balapan utama. Namun, hasil tersebut belum cukup untuk memangkas jaraknya dengan Marc Marquez . Baca juga: Skenario Marc Marquez Kunci Gelar Juara Dunia di MotoGP Portugal 2026 Saat ini, Martin masih tertinggal 16 poin dari pebalap Ducati tersebut. Marquez bahkan berpeluang mengunci gelar juara dunia di Portugal, apabila mampu unggul setidaknya dua poin dari Martin pada Sprint Race, Sabtu (21/11/2026). AFP/MOHD RASFAN Marc Marquez, merayakan kemenangannya di podium dalam upacara penyerahan trofi MotoGP Malaysia 2026 di Sirkuit Internasional Sepang, Minggu (1/11/2026). Peluang Martin untuk mempertahankan gelar juara dunia memang semakin sulit. Ia harus memangkas jarak hingga setidaknya 36 poin dari Marquez setelah Grand Prix Portugal, agar persaingan gelar tetap berlanjut hingga Valencia. Artinya, Martin perlu meraih keunggulan minimal 24 poin atas Marquez sepanjang akhir pekan di Portimao. Situasi tersebut bukan perkara mudah, mengingat satu-satunya momen Martin mampu membuat selisih poin sebesar itu musim ini terjadi di Le Mans. Saat itu, Martin berhasil meraih kemenangan ganda, sementara Marquez mengalami cedera kaki setelah terjatuh pada Sprint Race. Baca juga: Klasemen MotoGP Qatar 2026, Marquez Makin Dekati Gelar Juara Dunia Meski demikian, Martin tetap optimistis menghadapi dua seri terakhir musim ini. Kondisi fisiknya yang semakin membaik menjadi modal penting untuk kembali bersaing di barisan depan. Dok. Kondisi fisik saya jauh lebih baik saat datang ke Portugal, dan saya ingin memberikan yang terbaik bersama Aprilia dan seluruh tim saya," kata Martin, dikutip dari Crash.net, Selasa (17/11/2026). Saya tidak sabar untuk balapan di Portimao. Ini adalah trek yang saya sukai, kata Martin. Sementara itu, peluang rekan setim Martin, Marco Bezzecchi, untuk merebut gelar juara dunia 2026 juga semakin tipis. Meski sudah mengoleksi enam kemenangan Grand Prix sepanjang musim ini, dibandingkan Martin yang baru meraih satu kemenangan, Bezzecchi membutuhkan keajaiban untuk tetap berada dalam persaingan. AFP/LILLIAN SUWANRUMPHA Pebalap Italia dari Aprilia Racing Marco Bezzecchi beraksi dalam MotoGP Thailand 2026 di Sirkuit Internasional Buriram di Buriram pada 1 Maret 2026. (Foto oleh Lillian SUWANRUMPHA / AFP) Secara matematis, pebalap asal Italia tersebut harus memenangi seluruh empat balapan tersisa. Selain itu, Marquez juga harus gagal meraih satu poin pun agar peluang Bezzecchi tetap terbuka. Namun, bukan berarti Bezzecchi tidak memiliki target penting di dua seri terakhir. Aprilia masih berpeluang memperbaiki posisi dalam klasemen tim dan konstruktor. Dalam klasemen tim, Aprilia sudah unggul 124 poin atas Ducati Lenovo.
